speech.heard: 40.2% of women in Serbia use tobacco. In China, it is 1.5%. Bulgaria has 36.7%. Across the Balkans, the habit is widespread. In China, only 1.5% of women use tobacco. Serbia has 27 times the tobacco use of China. USA has 11.6%. Germany is higher at 19.6%. Nigeria has 0.4%, Egypt has 0.4%, and North Korea is the world's lowest at 0%. The count includes water pipes and smokeless tobacco, but excludes e-cigarettes. How common is tobacco use among women where you live?
